Package com.example.goboard.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.goboard.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
GameController is the central coordinator of the Go game. Responsibilities: - Holds references to core game components (Board, Players, MoveValidator) - Delegates game actions to the current GameState - Manages state transitions (Playing → Scoring → GameOver)
